name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
title_zh: 抽象烂、文件大、条件疯长，它直接开喷
tagline_zh: 不是温和建议，是逐行拆解抽象泄漏、巨型文件和 if 雪崩。专治「能跑就行」的自我感动。
tagline_en: Not gentle advice — it dissects abstraction leaks, monster files, and if-cascades line by line. For when 'it.
desc_en: Run an extremely strict maintainability review for abstraction quality, giant files, and spaghetti-condition growth. Use for a thermo-nuclear code quality review, thermonuclear review, deep code quality audit, or especially harsh maintainability review.
why_zh: 它不查 bug，专查代码的「腐烂加速度」——抽象是否诚实、文件是否失控、条件是否在指数繁殖。
why_en: It ignores bugs and hunts decay velocity: dishonest abstractions, file bloat, exponential condition growth. Harsher than.
limit_zh: 只审 Python/JS/TS 单仓库；不跑测试、不查安全、不修代码，只输出带行号的问题清单和重构优先级。
limit_en: Only Python/JS/TS in a single repo. No tests, no security, no fixes — just a line-numbered issue list with refactor priorities. Under 500 lines.
title_en: A reviewer that roasts your worst code abstractions
